verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API lets developers create and update broadcasts whose `content` is HTML and which reference an email template (kit-docs-66, kit-docs-70, kit-docs-71). Custom-field keys act as personalization tags in broadcasts and sequences, which gives basic variable substitution (kit-docs-74, kit-docs-75). So HTML email bodies can be pushed from code kept in version control. However, there is no evidence of a template management API, MJML support, or a template-as-code or version-control workflow; the templates themselves appear editor-managed. Missing for 10: email-template CRUD via API, MJML support, documented substitution syntax/templating language, version-control or CI integration for templates, independent corroboration.
